items.headline: 科沃島熄燈護幼海鳥
items.context: 葡萄牙亞速爾群島（Azores）的科沃島（Corvo），每年秋天會連續五個晚上關掉公共照明，幫助剛離巢的科氏鸌（Cory's shearwater）靠星光飛向大海。這個做法從 2019 年開始，起因是 1991 年當地居民發現大量幼鳥死亡。
items.thread_text:
葡萄牙亞速爾群島（Azores）中，最北、最小的島科沃島（Corvo）每年秋天都會暗下來。從 2019 年開始，島上約 450 位居民會在這幾個晚上連續關掉公共照明五個晚上，幫助剛離巢的科氏鸌（Cory's shearwater）——一種只生活在大西洋的海鳥——靠著星光飛向大海。這個做法源自 1991 年，當時居民發現大量幼鳥因為人工燈光而死亡。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 10 月 25 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

sources.summary: Whether he’s playing the role of soul-baring artist or starry producer, the Bleachers frontman strives to keep his integrity intact. He weighs in on Ed Sheeran, his love of working on ‘high-stakes’ albums and why he’s standing by the songs about his marriage Sitting in the restaurant of a Denver hotel, in the middle of a US tour with his band Bleachers, Jack Antonoff shrugs. “There’s this intense need to figure me out,” he frowns, “and I don’t really know where it comes from, because I keep explaining all of it. ” He has a point. For the last 12 years, Bleachers have released a succession of albums packed with Antonoff’s strikingly personal and frank songs. Being strikingly personal and frank was the whole point. Antonoff had previously been guitarist in Fun, a pop-rock band who went supernova with their 2011 single We Are Young. Despite co-writing a song that sold 10m copies in the US alone, Antonoff says he “hated” the experience “because I wasn’t the leader, they weren’t my words, and I needed to write a song that if I fucking died tomorrow would be my life story”. items.context: 英國心理魔術師德倫·布朗（Derren Brown）在倫敦阿波羅劇院（Apollo theatre）推出新作《Only Human》，靈感來自諾斯特拉達姆斯（Nostradamus）的預言能力。劇評指出，比起他過去令人驚豔的作品，這次的招式稍嫌後勁不足。
items.thread_text:
英國心理魔術師德倫·布朗（Derren Brown）在倫敦阿波羅劇院（Apollo theatre）推出新作《Only Human》，靈感來自諾斯特拉達姆斯（Nostradamus）的預言能力——他設計了一個讓全場觀眾一起到隔壁建築占測水脈的橋段，也讓一位被催眠的觀眾重演一次瀕死經驗。劇評認為，比起布朗過去令人驚豔的作品，這次中場前的表演稍嫌後勁不足：猜觀眾是非題答案的橋段確實神準，但賭注不高；占測水脈那段更直接失手，三位受試者裡只有一人成功，場地也太擁擠。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Apollo theatre, London Prophecies are impossibly fulfilled by the superstar who takes his cue from the legendary French seer in his show Only Human Do we have free will – or are the words I am about to write, the four stars twinkling atop this review, pre-ordained? That’s the stuff Derren Brown conjures with in his new show Only Human, which takes its inspiration from Nostradamus’s ability to foresee the future. Nostradamus used divination techniques – and so Brown engineers a stunt in which his audience, en masse, dowse a waterway in the building next door. Nostradamus had a near-death experience – and so, in one remarkable sequence, Brown orchestrates something similar for a hypnotised member of his crowd. This of course is territory Brown has always made his own : strip away the free will rhetoric and Nostradamus folderol, and artful dodger Derren stands revealed, doing the same mentalism and mesmerism tricks as ever. By the interval (and acknowledging that we’ve been spoiled by his jaw-dropping back catalogue), this current collection of stunts doesn’t feel all that high-powered. Predicting an audience member’s yes/no answers to a series of questions is amazing, yes, but low stakes. And that water divination set-piece misfires: only one of his three selected dowsers is up to the task, and the venue’s seating is too cramped for the mass mobility the routine requires. items.context: 曾經只出現在時裝秀上的「醜鞋」，正快速走進日常生活。比起過去那些低調樸素的通勤鞋款，現在越來越多人選擇又扁又帶點矯正鞋氣質、被網路戲稱「醜」的設計。
